[Image #1] how can i remove the .worktrees from the commit/branch/pr

`.gitignore` won’t remove files Git already tracks. Run this from the repository root on your PR branch:

```powershell
git rm -r --cached -- .worktrees
git commit -m "Remove tracked worktrees"
git push
```

This removes `.worktrees` from Git tracking **while keeping your local worktree directories intact**. Your existing `.worktrees/*` ignore rule prevents them from being added again.

The PR updates automatically after pushing. They’ll disappear from the final PR diff, though the earlier commit will still contain them.
I’ll remove `.worktrees` from Git tracking, keep the local directories, and commit and push the change on the current branch.
